findings: Reject: commit 8895b9de fixes the parsing order but not the full mechanism claim, because URL-bearing package modifiers are still dropped from the Rust model.
A no-URL control passes, while both ordinary-package and explicit-node URL cases fail with the missing Java <a> wrapper as the first structural divergence.
